SIGNATURE NEST GIFTS LLC

Service Terms

Effective November 11, 2026

This website introduces the services of Signature Nest Gifts LLC. The scope, fees, responsibilities and terms of any engagement are set out in a written service agreement with the client.

Available services

Our primary services are Etsy Shop Management, Sales Reporting & Reconciliation, Listing Creation & SEO Optimisation, Etsy Ads Management and Buyer Customer Care. Amazon and Shopify support is subject to an individually agreed scope.

Quotes and fees

Submitting an enquiry does not purchase a service or create a paid engagement. Pricing depends on the agreed scope. Monthly and per-listing fees may apply. Marketplace fees, payment-processing fees and advertising spend are separate from service fees unless expressly stated otherwise in the agreement.

Client ownership and responsibilities

Clients remain the owners and account holders of their shops and associated payment accounts. Clients are responsible for their products, rights to listing content, pricing and business decisions. Access and responsibilities for operational work are agreed during onboarding.

Results and platform decisions

We do not guarantee sales, search rankings, conversion rates, reviews, Star Seller status, reinstatement or any other platform outcome. Marketplace and payment-provider decisions remain outside our control.

Cancellation and refunds

Cancellation, notice periods, amounts due and any refund arrangements are governed by the written service agreement. Contact us to discuss your engagement. The product shipping and merchandise-return policies from the former retail website do not describe these services.

Independent provider

Signature Nest Gifts LLC is an independent service provider and is not affiliated with or endorsed by Etsy, Amazon or Shopify. Platform names and trademarks belong to their respective owners.
